surfaces.label: Live automatic combat and causal feedback
Reusable authored controls, status, selection, and result chrome

assets.label: Fixed-scale generated motif kit for the deterministic native-grid UI system

gates.label: Current shipping-camera engine capture
findings: All stills and the fixed-step motion sequence were recaptured from the current Godot implementation.

gates.label: One-swap formation read
findings: Rear, center, and front roles are named next to the units and remain visible during combat.
The deterministic contract resolves the intended single swap through the real combat loop.

gates.label: Unified production art direction
findings: Runtime characters, fixed-scale generated motifs, deterministic UI geometry, type, particles, and palette share one deliberate low-resolution language.
Generated source sheets are never loaded by the runtime.
Board, result, button, slot, meter, and progress geometry share one 2-pixel border, 4-pixel inset, native scale, and spacing contract; generated motifs provide ornament without controlling layout.

gates.label: Planning, selected, combat, and replay states
findings: The primary interaction states have distinct focus, copy, control, and feedback treatments.

gates.label: Gameplay-causal combat motion
findings: The engine-recorded sequence shows ignition, whole-pixel anticipation and lunges, curved travel, delayed impacts, hit-stop, recoil, formation links, Warden blocks, Seer chain arcs, Chime pulses, animated enemy defeats, and the staged result reveal.
Motion resolves the same health and outcome state exercised by the deterministic runtime contract; it is not an external promo reconstruction.

gates.label: Authored reusable interface vocabulary
findings: Six isolated ImageGen motifs were aspect-preserved, palette-locked, and compiled directly into their final native dimensions; runtime placement is always 1:1.
All structural UI is assembled from one deterministic geometry contract rather than independently generated panels with unrelated scale.
The current Godot captures prove normal, selected, combat-status, and resolved interface states.

gates.label: Pixel grid and asset maturity
findings: All six characters and six UI motifs are palette-locked PNGs rendered nearest-neighbor at integer scale.
The motif compiler uses pinned equal-grid cells, hard alpha, aspect-preserved fitting, exact final dimensions, and the same 16-color palette as the character compiler.
Godot detected the bundled face as a pixel font and disabled subpixel positioning and hinting.

metadata.scope: One encounter production slice, not a full content-complete game.

uiGeometry.texturePolicy: Compiled motifs render 1:1 at final native dimensions; structural geometry is deterministic; no runtime texture stretching.
